name: reqif.export
title: Export ReqIF
summary: Export a selection, or with `statements` or `sourceModel` the elements of the mapping's source, as ReqIF 1.2: IDENTIFIER `_` plus the UUID, text as XHTML and as `reqseq-markdown`, relations as SPEC-RELATIONs, targets outside the export as stubs.
details: With `statements`, each element goes by its source IDENTIFIER with only its statement. With `sourceModel`, it goes by its source IDENTIFIER in the source's types and attributes, without `reqseq-markdown` and without SPEC-RELATIONs; a value that does not fit its attribute refuses the export.
whileReadOnlyReason: Exports the types and properties of the metamodel, which is missing or faulty.

output.description: The ReqIF file to write: a new file, or a ReqIF file that is replaced.

selection.description: The elements to export; without it every element.

profile.description: Name of a saved export profile of the mapping. Not taken yet: it gives `input.invalid`.

mapping.description: The mapping file of the source the export goes to: the properties it omits are left out of the file. Needed with `statements` or `sourceModel`.

omitProperties.description: Added to the omitted properties of the mapping and the profile; with mapping, saved in it for later deliveries.

statements.description: Export the elements of the mapping's source with their statements, back to that source; needs `mapping`.

sourceModel.description: Write the elements of the mapping's source in the source's own types, attributes and IDENTIFIERs, which imports stored in the mapping (`source-model`); needs `mapping`. Refused, writing nothing, when a value does not fit or the mapping is ambiguous.

file.title: ReqIF file
file.description: The written ReqIF file, relative to the workspace root when it lies inside, else absolute.

withoutStatement.title: Without statement
withoutStatement.description: With statements: exported elements without a statement, those of `elementsWithoutStatement`.

exportedElements.title: Exported elements
exportedElements.description: The exported elements, in the order of the file.

elementsWithoutStatement.title: Without statement
elementsWithoutStatement.description: With statements: the exported elements without a statement, in the order of the file; empty without statements.

items.description: Copied image or saved mapping file, relative to the workspace root.
